text_block_list.text:
Summer camp is now over with Meisho
Doto
having completed numerous trials
in her search
for ambition. The result of
her endeavor...
Uugh, I'm so sorry about this...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
...Is rather mute, despite our attempts to
toughen
her up.

Um... I don't think I have it in me to push
past my
competition...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
I'll have to study! I'll use this autumn to
prepare...
for the eventual future.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
I can't prove it, but I think things will be
okay if I
follow Opera O and Ayabe.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Opera O is always confident, and Ayabe
is always
looking far ahead...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Those two are amazing, always making
the right
decisions. If I think of them as
my mentors, then
just maybe...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Yes! I believe it will—because those two
are very
dear to me.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Trainer, could you... believe in my choice
too?
For me? Um, even just a little bit is
fine...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото
choice_data_list: All right, I'll believe in your decision.

text_block_list.text: Of course! Those who choose to believe in me will never suffer! Haaah ha ha!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
As long as you don't get in my way, I
won't stop
you.
text_block_list.name: Адмайр Вега

text_block_list.text: Thank you so much, Opera O, Ayabe!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: I just know if I follow you two... I'll...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
The ceiling that hampers Мэйсё Дото's
growth is
as heavy as ever. But this
autumn... hopefully, her
peers will show
her what it means to compete.
